text:
Elle: Quick sync — Satellite beta cohort (B) invites: we need to stagger enrollments across EMEA/APAC/NA so our onboarding calls don't overlap and so AEs can own follow-ups. Thinking Tues (EMEA), Wed (NA), Thu (APAC). Thoughts?

Ravi: Sounds good. How many seats per day? We have 45 total for this cohort. Recommend 15/day to keep support load manageable.

Jordan: 15/day works. I can block 2x 30-min intro slots each day for AEs and share calendar invites. Will follow up with attendee list. @Elle can you confirm the list export?

Elle: Will export CSV now — command I use: `./tools/export_cohort.sh --cohort satellite-B --fields name,email,company,timezone > satellite-B.csv`

Sophie: For feedback capture, let's run a micro-survey after first session: 3 quick Qs (ease of setup, relevance, biggest blocker). Proposal: embed survey link in the post-onboard email and collect screenshots of first-reply experience for UX. Draft micro-survey: 1) How easy was initial setup? (1-5) 2) Did the model outputs match expectations? (Y/N + comment) 3) Biggest blocker? (open)

Jordan: Can we also include an optional short call-to-action for power users to join an advanced session? I can seed it in AE invites.

Ravi: Ops question — are we gating invites by feature flags? A few customers should have earlier access to KV-cache previews. Need a flag list.

Elle: Yes gating is via flag `satellite_beta_kv_preview`. I'll attach a small column in the CSV. Also will mark high-risk renewal accounts so CSMs can prioritize.

OnboardBot: Automation scheduled: invites queued for 2026-05-12T09:00Z (EMEA), 2026-05-13T14:00Z (NA), 2026-05-14T00:00Z (APAC). Event templates: `satellite-beta-onboard-v1`.

Sophie: Love the automation. One more ask — can we capture a short session recording permission checkbox in the invite so we can clip for internal review?

Elle: Yup. I'll add `recording_ok` column to CSV and update the template.

Jordan: I'll coordinate AEs for follow-ups and collect notes in the shared doc: https://redwood.example.com/satellite-B/notes. Plan to tag any immediate regen/accuracy issues as P0 for ML/eng triage.

Ravi: For renewal risk signal, let's flag accounts with <3 invites accepted or survey NPS <= 3. I'll add a segment query and share results by EOD.

Sophie: I'll draft the micro-survey email copy and share in #customer-success-drafts for a quick review.

Elle: Next steps: 1) Elle exports CSV + adds flags/recording_ok (today) 2) OnboardBot to run invites at scheduled times 3) Jordan/AEs run intro calls and add notes 4) Sophie publishes micro-survey + email copy 5) Ravi runs renewal-risk segment and shares results.

Ravi: +1 to plan.

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Sophie: I'll drop the draft in 30m.

Elle: Thanks team — will ping here once CSV and template are updated.
